# Pricing review

# Pricing
- **decide Pro price**
  - Three options were on the table: $10, $12 and $15 per seat per month.
  - $15 per seat tested badly — churn in the survey group roughly doubled above $12.
  - Decision: **$12 per seat per month**. Everyone on the call agreed.
- trial length?
  - Priya proposed a **14-day free trial instead of the current 7 days**.
  - Agreed and confirmed as a decision: 14-day trial.

# Next steps
- legal review
  - Me will get legal to review the trial terms **before we publish**.
- Marcus will update the pricing page **by Friday the 14th**.
- Annual discounts will be revisited on **March 3rd** — explicitly not now.

## Summary
The meeting was about settling pricing for the Pro plan. After reviewing three price points ($10, $12, $15 per seat per month) and survey data showing churn roughly doubled above $12, the team agreed on $12 per seat per month and a 14-day free trial instead of 7 days. Follow-ups cover the pricing page update, legal review of the trial terms, and a later discussion of annual discounts.

## Key Points
- Three pricing options were evaluated: $10, $12 and $15 per seat per month.
- $15 per seat tested badly; churn in the survey group roughly doubled above $12.
- Priya raised extending the free trial from 7 days to 14 days.
- Annual discounts were raised but deferred to March 3rd.

## Decisions
- Pro plan price set at $12 per seat per month.
- Free trial set at 14 days instead of 7 days.
- Annual discounts deferred — to be revisited on March 3rd.

## Action Items
- Update the pricing page by Friday the 14th — Marcus.
- Get legal to review the trial terms before publishing — Me.
- Revisit annual discounts on March 3rd — team.
